term: bounded metric age in a past with no first moment
definition: The time carrier is Mathlib Set.Ioc (0:Real) 1: real clock readings strictly greater than0 and at most1, with the inherited strict real order. The selected now has reading1. Clock age is ordinary real subtraction now.val-t.val. Every age is nonnegative and strictly below1. This bounded chosen metric says nothing by itself about an earliest member; the original PastIsFinite/PastIsInfinite predicates still concern earlier-time order.
note: Source-free mathematical interval control. Half the positive reading lies in the interval and is earlier. The clock scale and the excluded left endpoint are specified mathematical data, not physical realization, a privileged cosmological parametrization or a physical causal law. No new semantic primitive replaces the original temporal predicates.
